Players Committee card image of [[Vaneé (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -3 to a site with 'Vader' in game text. Once during your turn, may activate 1 Force. Once per game, may take a card with 'Vader' in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/vanee_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/509151e2a81ba946389cdd7b3468137a459c5ad5 509151e] (2 December 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
